name: Tierell
description: Tierell was a planet located in the Tierell system within the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
lead_paragraphs: Tierell was a planet located in the Tierell system within the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Located at the intersection of the Hydian Way and the Junction-Tierell Loop, Tierell and the planet Feriae Junction were the two ports that serve most traffic coming and going from the Loop Worlds of the Gordian Reach.
